title: 'Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!' Manga Takes Break
content: This year's 24th issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine announced on Wednesday that Muchimaro 's Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! manga will take a break until the 27th issue on June 3 due to the artist's health. The announcement also stated that artist Muchimaro 's health is improving.
author: ANN

title: King of the Hill Releases New Preview For Season 15
content: King of the Hill’s long-awaited revival on Hulu became one of the biggest shows on the streaming service in 2025, and it looks like the residents of Arlen, Texas, are seeing if they can one-up the previous season this summer.

title: Paru Itagaki's Beast Complex Manga Gets New 1-Shot
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Paru Itagaki 's works announced on Wednesday that the Beast Complex manga will get a new one-shot story in summer. The series received a new chapter in Akita Shoten 's Weekly Shōnen Champion magazine in December 2022.
author: ANN

title: TBS' Sand B Company Acquires Xenotoon CG Anime Studio
content: Tokyo Broadcasting System ( TBS ) Holdings' Sand B anime planning and development company acquired a 51% controlling stake in 3D CG anime studio Xenotoon, turning the studio into a subsidiary company of Sand B.
author: ANN

title: 'Black Torch' Announces Additional Cast, Staff
content: The official website for Black Torch television anime announced additional cast and staff on Friday. The anime series adapting Tsuyoshi Takaki 's action supernatural manga is scheduled to premiere on Tokyo MX and other stations on July 4.
